canonical_reference.role: Mandatory editorial, design and prepublication reference for every executivesaudi post
canonical_reference.owner_instruction: احفظ كل اعدادات التحرير والتصميم وتصير مرجع دائم لكل منشور
canonical_reference.precedence: Latest explicit Khalid correction overrides older conflicting guidance; challenge-specific rules override general information-card rules only within challenges.
canonical_reference.persistence: Update this same file identity; do not create competing masters. Preserve approved challenge rules and historical receipts.
canonical_reference.enforcement_status: Mandatory agent preflight linked from repository AGENTS.md. Existing publisher retains its gates. This JSON is not yet a universal executable renderer/validator; do not claim automated enforcement for every field.

editorial_master.language: Everyday Saudi Arabic, conversational salfa; no vowel marks or tanween, no heavy formal narration.
avoid: بس سالفتها ما انتهت هنا as filler
editorial_master.tone: Everyday Saudi salfa, light humor when appropriate. At most one emoji. Latest owner-selected appearance 😄 overrides older 🙂-only guidance. Do not invent motives.
editorial_master.selection: Both the current trigger AND the associated story must feel close to ordinary people in Saudi Arabia. A familiar trigger alone is insufficient.
editorial_master.trigger: Verify event date itself in Riyadh, not article repost date. Distinguish today, upcoming and ended. Put the trigger first when relevant; never invent a current event for an evergreen Saudi selection.
editorial_master.research: Scan principal Saudi, Arabic and international headlines then compare a second time. Do not favor easy research or available images over importance. Do not fill quotas with weak stories.
editorial_master.value: A specific surprising shareable fact, a clear cause, turning point and meaningful outcome. Avoid obvious facts, repeated information and unsupported company claims.
editorial_master.story_order: Open with a relatable situation, explain why the change happened and who did what, then the turning point and where it led. Keep causal links when shortening.
editorial_master.factual_controls: Verify names, dates, locations, acquisitions, branch counts and historical photos. Do not infer store location from headquarters. Name coverage sources before calling a story widespread. Separate verified facts from humor and inference.
editorial_master.scope: Avoid narrow scientific, environmental, wildlife and celebrity topics without explicit strong public relevance or owner selection.
editorial_master.repetition: Check available recent drafts, selections and posted packages; no repeat without a material new development explained.
editorial_master.workflow: Finalize trigger, fact and story sequence before design. Lock one approved text version; change only requested elements. No design before selection and no publication before authorization.
editorial_master.closing: A strong relevant outcome, preferably where they reached today when verified. Do not force a question; optional questions must be gentle and never pressuring.
editorial_master.cta_exact: شاركها مع صديقك اللي تعجبه هذي المعلومة.
editorial_master.tables: If a table is genuinely useful, add one introductory sentence and one closing sentence; label dates and units clearly.

palette_regression.root_cause: Fuzzy replacement failed to match original body ink near #003770, not #0B3656. No-op was not checked; resizing also followed normalization.
palette_regression.rule: Never infer palette success from command exit status, prompt, or pre-resize samples. Preserve photo pixels. Use fixed template colors from inception, not generated colors.
palette_regression.enforcement: Mandatory agent review, not universal automated pipeline enforcement.

production_acceptance_gate.format: One card when sufficient; maximum two. Short bullets; no more than two rendered lines per bullet. Prefer one readable title line; maximum two closing lines. Shorten meaningfully instead of shrinking font.
production_acceptance_gate.canvas: Before ANY user-facing preview or approval, exported bytes MUST measure exactly 1080x1920. Compose on this canvas from the start. Raw generator output is internal only, not an approval preview. If output differs, normalize without distortion or cropping meaningful content and verify dimensions before display; a prompt or 9:16 appearance is not proof.
production_acceptance_gate.palette: Apply palette.exact_numeric_tokens numerically in template/rendering or deterministic postprocessing. A generation prompt alone is never enforcement. Verify flat/interior pixels, allowing only antialiasing blends; preserve photographic colors.
production_acceptance_gate.template: Start from the approved master, not a newly imagined identity. Retain header, original logos, font appearance, color roles, rounded panels and footer. Do not claim an exact font family without an original font/template.
production_acceptance_gate.images: Use meaningful sourced images or owner-supplied assets; founder/start paired with recognizable relevant product when suitable. Never invent archival evidence or label an unrelated shop as the original. Disclose generated illustrations; do not represent generated product packaging as official photography.
production_acceptance_gate.captions: Mandatory small readable gray #7A7973 caption directly under each image. Check left/right mapping visually. State precisely what is shown; no unsupported first-product or founder identity claims.
production_acceptance_gate.spacing: Uniform readable text, comfortable margins, no overlaps or excessive gaps. Never crop face or distort proportions to force a layout. Inspect final raster at mobile width around 390 pixels.
production_acceptance_gate.public_content: No sources card, PDF, watermarks from unlicensed stock, or research notes in public output. Preserve legally required attribution when applicable.

production_acceptance_gate.exception_policy: No invented font metrics or false pass records. Never weaken a guard or reuse an old hash-specific exception to publish another card. Any necessary exception needs explicit specific authorization and evidence.

layout.overflow_policy: No automatic font shrinking, cropping, condensed lettering, font substitution or loss of CTA. Shorten approved text only with owner authorization; otherwise use up to two cards and obtain design approval.
